text: My most memorable trip was to Vietnam, and it taught me that thorough planning can make a journey smoother, but spontaneity makes it exciting. I spent weeks researching, but the real adventure began when I tasted street food that I couldn’t name and wandered through bustling markets. The language barrier was a challenge, so I relied on hand gestures and a translation app, which often led to laughter. Despite the confusion, the locals were incredibly patient. Immersing myself in a new culture, from eating pho at dawn to learning to bargain, created memories I still cherish today. Now, I always save room in my itinerary for the unexpected.
